on_battle_start: Welcome to my greenhouse. Every leaf here has a purpose. Do you?
Nature always finds a way. Let's see if you can keep up.
on_battle_won: The garden thrives, but you wither. Come back when you've grown.
Even the toughest weeds get pulled eventually.
on_battle_lost: You've bloomed into quite the trainer. Take this badge.
The greenhouse yields to your strength. Well grown, indeed.
